name: daedalus
description: Shared engineering rules and workflow plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: daedalus-core
plugins.description: Shared engineering rules loaded at session start and a security-review skill, with Matt Pocock's skills as the engineering workflow.

plugins.name: daedalus-springboot
plugins.description: Spring Boot conventions, patterns, security, verification, hexagonal architecture, JPA and PostgreSQL skills, plus a Java build-error agent.

plugins.name: daedalus-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure: Docker patterns, plus the official AWS (aws-core) and Terraform plugins.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Third-party (JuliusBrussee/caveman 4.1.0), pinned to a reviewed commit: terse replies.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Third-party (DietrichGebert/ponytail 5.3.3), pinned to a reviewed commit: simplest working solution.
